sentences.en: We soundproofed our basement and use it as a recording studio.
sentences.zh: 我们给地下室做了隔音处理，现在用作录音室。

sentences.en: Yanni didn't hear a thing from his soundproof office.
sentences.zh: 杨尼在他的隔音办公室里根本听不到外面的声音。

sentences.en: It's a guest room equipped with soundproofing with an emphasis on privacy.
sentences.zh: 这间客房配备了隔音设施，注重隐私性。
